acceptanceCriteria: A provider with several thousand tests (fixture above 1,024) plans without e2e-bound-exceeded.
Above the documented ceiling the closed refusal is unchanged.
Measured memory/time and output size at the new ceiling are retained; omitted_tests is digest-summarised if needed.
Spec bound updated with acceptance evidence.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1079 (opened 2026-10-17). The e2e-safe provider bounds inventory at 1,024 tests and each path list at 4,096; a suite with one test per behaviour variation passes 1,024 quickly and then every plan returns e2e-bound-exceeded (full suite), so selection stops working exactly where it saves most. Request: raise the bounds to fit several-thousand-test suites, or make them configurable under a documented ceiling, keeping the closed refusal above the ceiling; summarise omitted_tests by digest as plan.excluded already is if output size is the concern.
title: affected e2e-safe: raise or make configurable the 1,024-test inventory and 4,096 path-list bounds (issue #1079)
